card.name: Punctuation before edema in pioglitazone text
card.fires_on: Commas, parentheses and linking words like "with" or "to" in pioglitazone label text, just before words like edema, insulin or placebo. It is strongest in the edema and fluid retention warnings.

modes.label: Comma before edema
modes.description: A comma right before edema or a similar adverse effect in the pioglitazone warnings.
modes.example: 5.5 Edema In controlled clinical trials<<,>> edema was reported more frequently in patients

modes.label: Linking word before a comparator
modes.description: The word "with" or "to" before insulin or placebo in pioglitazone combination or randomization statements.
modes.example: most common when pioglitazone is used in combination<< with>> insulin.

modes.label: Closing parenthesis after trial size
modes.description: A parenthesis or comma after a patient count or symptom list in pioglitazone trial descriptions.
modes.example: randomized to pioglitazone (N=2,605<<),>> force-titrated up to 4
